steps.summary: Signed in successfully as Bench User (email bench@example.com). The page navigated from the login screen to the Repair Tickets view at #/tickets, which shows 13 repair tickets in a paginated table (columns: Ref, Title, Customer, Status, Parts, Created) with statuses like Draft and Ready. The navigation bar displays the username "Bench User" and a Sign out button, confirming the session is active.

Created new repair ticket "fwrd41-n3 RD Bench Ticket". The New ticket dialog had two fields: Title (required, marked with *) and Customer (optional). Filled only the title and clicked Create. The ticket appears first in the list at #/tickets with Ref RD-1017, title "fwrd41-n3 RD Bench Ticket", status "Draft", customer "Not recorded", 0 parts, created 2026-09-03. Successfully verified in the tickets table.
Replayed stored procedure s_cab22e; observed part_name=fwrd41-n3 RD Part A, part_cost=$100.00, part_markup=25%, part_qty=1, part_supplier=No supplier, part_price=$125.00.

Added second part "fwrd41-n3 RD Part B" to ticket RD-1017. The add-part dialog fields (Name, Cost, Markup, Quantity [default 1], Supplier [optional]) were filled: Name="fwrd41-n3 RD Part B", Cost=200, Markup=25, Qty=1, Supplier blank. Submitted successfully. The parts table now shows both parts: Part A ($100.00 cost, 25% markup → $125.00 price) and Part B ($200.00 cost, 25% markup → $250.00 price). The app calculates Price = Cost × (1 + Markup%) = $200 × 1.25 = $250.00. The overall Total (price × quantity) displayed is $375.00 ($125.00 + $250.00).

Edited Part A ("fwrd41-n3 RD Part A") via the "Edit part" dialog. Changed its cost from $100 to $150, keeping markup at 25% and quantity at 1. The dialog had fields: Name (read-only pre-filled), Cost, Markup, Quantity, and Supplier. After saving, the parts table confirms: Part A now shows Cost $150.00, Markup 25%, Qty 1, Price $187.50 (the app computes Price = Cost × 1.25 = $150 × 1.25 = $187.50). Part B unchanged at $250.00 price. The overall Total (price × qty) is now $437.50 ($187.50 + $250.00).
Replayed stored procedure s_9d934c; observed status_after_attempt=Draft.
Replayed stored procedure s_adc2ef; observed ticket_status_final=Ready.

Deleted both parts from ticket RD-1017. Each part row had a Delete button that opened a "Confirm" dialog (heading "Confirm", with "Cancel" and "Delete part" buttons). Clicking "Delete part" removed the part and the table refreshed. After removing Part A first, then Part B, the parts table now shows "No parts on this ticket yet." — confirming 0 parts remain. The ticket's status stayed "Ready" throughout; it did not automatically revert to Draft when parts were removed. The status badge still reads "Ready" and the action buttons are "Mark Draft" and "Mark Closed".
